summary.en: Miwako Sato reminisces about the bomber case three years ago in which a bomber sent a fax to the Tokyo Metropolitan Police containing the location of a bomb in the form of a riddle. Jinpei Matsuda deduced the bomb's location and realizes that the bomb contains a clue to an even larger bomb and that the clue is only revealed during the last three seconds before detonation; Matsuda sacrifices his life and allowed the police to locate the second bomb. In the present time, the bomber returns and sends a fax to the Police station. Kenji Hagiwara thought that it was safe, when suddenly the timer on bomb started again and although he tried he failed to escape and died in the explosion. Jinpei Matsuda was confident that he could disable the bomb, but a message on the l.e.d screen forced him to stay in the Ferris wheel and he ended up dying in the resulting explosion. Jinpei Matsuda sent the hint that appeared three seconds before the detonation of the bomb in the ferris wheel to Sato, as a result the police were able to pinpoint the location of a second, larger bomb and disarm it. Shiratori managed to escape his Lexus LS400 before he caught the brunt of the blast. He sustained major injuries, that forced him to be hospitalized.
